subject: Banking
title: Credit Repair Scams
description: A short lesson to help you apply Credit Repair Scams.

hook.text: Credit repair companies promise to boost your score for $100/month. Most do nothing you can't do yourself for free.

buildup.text: They flood bureaus with disputes, hoping items get removed due to administrative overload. This is called 'jamming.'

discovery.text: Legitimate disputes are free through annualcreditreport.com.

twist.text: Some credit repair firms create fake identities using new SSN combinations.

climax.text: Credit repair is a $10 billion industry that mostly sells services consumers can do for free. Knowledge is the real fix.

punchline.text: $10 billion industry. Everything they do, you can do for free by law.

quiz.question: What can credit repair companies do that you can't do yourself?
options: Nothing—you have the same legal dispute rights for free

details.summary: Credit repair companies promise to fix bad credit scores for upfront fees but often deliver nothing that consumers cannot do themselves for free. Many use illegal tactics like disputing accurate information or creating fake identities.
details.whyItMatters: Desperate consumers with poor credit are vulnerable to fraud. Legitimate credit repair involves disputing genuinely inaccurate information, which anyone can do for free. Understanding this protects people from predatory companies.
takeaways: No company can legally remove accurate negative information from your report
Upfront fees before services are performed violate federal law
Everything credit repair companies do, consumers can do for free

faq.question: How can you tell if a credit repair company is a scam?
faq.answer: Red flags include upfront payment demands, promises to remove accurate information, suggestions to create a new identity or credit profile number, and guarantees of specific score increases. Legitimate companies explain your free self-help rights.

faq.question: What can you do to improve credit without paying a company?
faq.answer: Dispute genuinely inaccurate items directly with credit bureaus for free. Pay down high balances, set up automatic payments, and become an authorized user on a responsible person's card. Time and responsible behavior improve scores naturally.
